scores.decision_correct_quote: **Q1:** Survivable **only** with scarce issuance (1/IP/day + global cap + flag), a shrunk browser envelope (10 jobs, 1 viewport, no 4k/full_page), IP limits actually applied to capture/render (including MCP), and a flag that freezes unclaimed trials without touching claimed accounts — not as a naked auto-provision on first tool use.

must_catch.quote: that cost is **not** bounded by `ABUSE_BUDGET` IP caps because `handleCapture` never calls `checkUploadRateLimit` ... `capture.ts:233-237` daily account limit only; `rate-limit.ts:16-40` IP hourly cap is `checkUploadRateLimit`, imported by `items-create.ts:70` not `capture.ts`

MCP then strips the client IP: `mcp.ts:1009-1013` builds `new Request("https://internal/api/v1/captures")` with no `CF-Connecting-IP`. ... missing IP currently fail-opens: `rate-limit.ts:21` `if (!ip) return { allowed: true }`

`AccountPlan` has no trial ... `types.ts:32` `AccountPlan = "free" | "pro" | "team" | "owner"` ... `constants.ts:43-51` free is already 50/day — trial must be a new `PLAN_LIMITS.trial` row, not `free`
`accounts.email` is `NOT NULL UNIQUE` ... `0001_initial_schema.sql:9` `email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE` ... FALSIFIER: A migration making `accounts.email` nullable

`capture.ts:25` `MAX_WAIT_MS = 25_000`; ... `capture.ts:546-548` "Maximum 6 viewports" ... forced single `desktop` viewport, `full_page` and `4k` rejected ... a farm at 10 jobs × many minted trials exhausts included hours and the 10-concurrency grant

A claim URL that attaches email on GET (the current magic-link verify shape) is a transcript bearer and is unacceptable; the surfaced value may only be a public index `https://whipnode.com/claim` plus a short `WHIP-XXXX` user_code ... finish needs bound `mcp_devices` + browser nonce ... FALSIFIER: Completing a claim with only the user_code from a transcript

The kill switch is `FEATURE_ENABLE_TRIAL_ISSUANCE` off ... existing `plan='trial' AND email IS NULL` rows may read/fetch but `handleCapture`/`handleRender` reject; rows with email set and `plan` in `{free,pro,team,owner}` are untouched

scores.notes: Memo lands the verified capture-path limiter bug plus the MCP IP-stripping/fail-open chain, avoids every landmine (non-bearer claim locator, in-place same-key conversion, complements `init`, migration for NOT NULL email), and its only divergence from the oracle is substituting a browser-only nonce POSTed by the bound device for the trial-key-authenticated poll — a different but still possession-proving mechanism, not a false objection.
